_comment: Generic worker registry. Edit binary/model/cost for your own setup. No real credentials here.

free_worker.note: Example: a CLI coding agent with a free tier (OpenCode Zen, a local model via its own CLI, etc).

paid_worker.note: Used only for hard/high-risk work or after the free worker fails. Cap spend per run in your adapter.

hermes.note: Web/browser/tool/coordination work that doesn't need a file-editing agent stays with Hermes itself.
